subtasks.name: lvl1-blue-on-blue
subtasks.prompt: put a blue cube on top of the other blue cube
subtasks.check: Is one blue cube resting on top of the other blue cube, not on the table?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the robot grippers.

subtasks.name: lvl2-pink-on-top
subtasks.prompt: put the pink cube on top of the blue cubes
subtasks.check: Is the pink cube resting on top of a stack of blue cubes, so three cubes are stacked?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the robot grippers.

subtasks.name: lvl3-stick-upright
subtasks.prompt: stand the yellow stick upright in the hole of the top cube
subtasks.check: Is the yellow stick standing upright in the hole of the top cube of the stack?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the robot grippers.
